<Rep. Nydia M. Velázquez>: Federal disaster relief programs are subject to periodic regulatory changes. In June 2023, SBA published a direct final rule to expand options for disaster loan recipients and reflect cost increases from inflation by increasing home lending limits and extending the deferment period for repayment. Similarly, in January 2024, the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) published an interim final rule amending its regulations governing Individual Assistance for major disasters, removing the requirement to apply for SBA disaster loans as a condition of eligibility for some types of assistance from FEMA.
On May 18, 2026, the Government Accountability Office issued a report that found that SBA's field operations centers did not consistently update SBA's disaster specific press releases or fact sheets to capture key components of the SBA's 2023 and FEMA's 2024 rules. According to SBA guidance, the field operations centers are responsible for outreach materials for declared disaster that affect localized areas which are the most common types of disasters. SBA relies on press releases and fact sheets to inform disaster survivors and the media about the program. While SBA has established a process for standardized outreach materials, GAO identified gaps in those controls.
When comparing outreach materials between east and west field operations centers, GAO found that While the Eastern Centers included increased limits and eligible uses for mitigation for all loans in most press releases, the Western Center did not. Similarly, the Eastern Center included information referencing FEMA's new rule in press releases, while the Western Center did not. Ensuring all potential borrowers have all relevant information when struck by a disaster is important to ensure all those that can be helped are helped. This bill requires the SBA to establish standard procedures to ensure disaster outreach materials are consistent across field operations centers, and ensure information is accurate and current.
Nydia M. Velazquez,
Ranking Member.
